title: Senior Frontend Engineer (LATAM)
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Front End Developer (LATAM) role at Lateral Group

Lateral stands for technology excellence. We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality. Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral Our mission is simple: design and build great products . What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work . We have a bias for action and results. We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results speak for themselves. We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality – Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to. We Care Deeply . We care about our work and about each other. Care is a competitive advantage. Every detail matters – every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default. We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do . Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way. We Keep Improving . The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning. We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection. We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto . We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around. We Take Ownership . Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Front End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality.
  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.
  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.
  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale and writing tests to prevent regressions.
  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. Stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience. You’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.

Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. You might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow.
  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.
  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How We Measure Success In This Role

In the first two weeks: You\'ve set up your development environment and tools. You\'ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature). You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style. You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project\'s context.

In the first 3 months: You\’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative. You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation. You\’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents. You\’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance. You\’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months: You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team. You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard). You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks. You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through: The impact and scope of your technical contributions. Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices. Code quality, performance, and maintainability. Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership. Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.
  • Proven ability to craft, polish, delight, sweat the details. You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.
  • Quality and reliability: You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments. Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.
  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.
  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about being kind, open, and constructive, so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.
  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft
  • Design /delight sensibility
  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling
  • Understanding Backend concepts
  • CSR/SSR
  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.
  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
  • We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.
  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.
  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace.
  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.
  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.
  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.
  • Feedback doesn\'t excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.
  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time. We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is
  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible
  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us:

  • A brief note telling us what excites you about this role
  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work — Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft
  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special
  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary
  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of. We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral\'s values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.
  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.
  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics
  • Motivators and demotivators.
  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.
  • Be ready to discuss challenges you\'ve overcome and lessons learned.
  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral\'s mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.
  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.
  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.

Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you\'d encounter in the position.
  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.
  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.
  • How you collaborate across disciplines.
  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.
  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.
  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: We’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you\'ve mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do this when we feel we need more context. We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out to due to confidentiality or other reasons. And here’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room.” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you\'ll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information. Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Overview

Sobre a Zippi

Somos um time de tecnologia enxuto e talentoso com a missão de ajudar pequenos negócios a prosperarem. Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito e pagamentos, lançando nossa solução em 2022. Hoje, já processamos mais de R$ 2 bilhões em transações por ano, mostrando o crescimento exponencial do nosso negócio. Recentemente, atingimos o breakeven, um marco que mostra a força do nosso modelo de negócios. Crescemos mais de 160% ao longo do ano de 2024, transacionando mais de R$ 250 milhões em um único mês, o que faz com que tenhamos um volume anualizado superior a R$ 3 bilhões de reais.

Existem no Brasil mais de 20 milhões de micro e pequenas empresas (MPEs) que movimentam coletivamente acima de R$ 1 trilhão por ano, mas muitas ainda não têm acesso a produtos financeiros que realmente atendam às suas necessidades. Na Zippi, estamos mudando esse cenário ao criar soluções financeiras personalizadas para o fluxo de caixa dos MPEs, começando com capital de giro via PIX. Através de nossa plataforma de pagamentos, nossos clientes compram suprimentos ao clicar um botão e têm até 10 dias para pagar, ganhando capital de giro para crescer seus negócios.

Nossa infraestrutura tecnológica é o que nos permite servir esses clientes e impulsiona nosso crescimento vertiginoso e rentável. Desenvolvemos uma plataforma capaz de processar um grande volume de dados e pagamentos e usar essas informações para fazer uma gestão da jornada do cliente altamente automatizada. Todo o ciclo de crédito é gerido por nós mesmos com uma abordagem inovadora, centrada em ciência de dados. Com um time movido pelo impacto e pela colaboração, e mais de US$ 20 milhões em investimentos de fundos renomados como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, estamos construindo um futuro onde os MPEs podem alcançar o sucesso fazendo o que amam.

Por que trabalhar com a gente:

- Você será um early team member , em uma startup de crescimento exponencial investida pela Y Combinator;

- Estamos crescendo muito rápido e somos bem financiados. Esta é uma oportunidade única de se juntar ao nosso foguete e ajudar a construir a empresa desde o início!

- Somos uma equipe unida, não hierárquica e intensa, trabalhando em uma grande oportunidade. Você ganhará uma experiência inestimável, aprenderá muito e terá ownership do seu trabalho;

- Trabalhe com um time de fundadores e operadores que possuem expertise global em tecnologia e serviços financeiros.

- Trabalhe por uma causa que vale a pena lutar: ajudar micro e pequenos negócios a prosperarem.

O que você pode esperar da gente

  • Learning Budget anual focado no seu desenvolvimento;
  • Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado;
  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi;

  • E principalmente, um ambiente irado para se trabalhar!

  • Avaliar a dieta, através de diferentes métodos, diagnosticando sua adequação frente às necessidades nutricionais e dietoterápicas, considerando o aporte por via oral e/ou enteral e/ou parenteral e aos hábitos alimentares, incluindo padrão alimentar quanto ao número, tipo de composição das refeições, disciplina, restrições e preferências alimentares e apetite;

  • Avaliar o estado nutricional do paciente, utilizando medidas antropométricas e exames laboratoriais, solicitados pelo Nutricionista ou por outro profissional (médico), a partir dos diversos métodos e técnicas cientificamente comprovados, considerando aspectos individuais e clínicos;

Prescrevendo dieta e/ou dietética, baseada nos diagnósticos nutricionais, considerando diagnósticos e condutas dos demais profissionais da equipe multiprofissional;

  • Exercer alta em nutrição, registrar e assinar no prontuário todo atendimento de nutrição prestado ao paciente;
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de protocolos de pesquisas, realizar a avaliação de custos do setor, assim como, participar das discussões técnicas de negociação e/ou renegociação de contratos voltados a nutrição e dietoterapias;

  • Colaborar com a formação e aprimoramento de outros profissionais de saúde, orientando estágios e participando de programas de treinamento nos serviços de saúde;
  • Efetuar controle periódico da qualidade e resolutividade do seu trabalho em relação aos pacientes que estão sendo atendidos pela equipe de fisioterapeutas;

Sobre a empresa

Fundada em 1952, a Savoy com mais de 70 anos de existência no mercado imobiliário. Um caminho iniciado com projetos de loteamentos no litoral paulista e na região metropolitana de São Paulo e a partir da década de 80, direcionados à locação de imóveis comerciais e industriais.

São mais de 7 décadas de dedicação que fazem da Savoy uma referência em locação de espaços empresariais, industriais e escritórios de todos os tamanhos, além de áreas para depósitos, centros empresariais e de distribuição logística, galerias, lojas em shopping centers, imóveis na via pública, terrenos para novos usos, etc. Ou seja, inúmeros formatos de espaços para as mais diversas atividades e negócios.

A nossa missão é oferecer instalações comerciais para que o cliente possa estabelecer o seu negócio e prosperar, estando sempre atento às necessidades e oferecendo soluções de qualidade.

Como princípios estão nossos compromissos de estarmos sempre atentos às necessidades dos nossos clientes e participarmos ativamente do cotidiano da empresa, adaptando-nos adequadamente às novas situações e impulsionando mudanças, comunicarmo-nos de forma correta e tendo como objetivo a melhoria do ambiente de trabalho, colaborarmos sempre com boa vontade para atingir os objetivos da equipe e tomar iniciativas constantes para o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal de todos.

Nossa busca contínua pelos bons resultados passa pela eficiência na utilização dos recursos, tendo como meta atingir a melhor manutenção de nossas instalações para que elas possam ser locadas rapidamente.

A história da nossa empresa mostra que o seu crescimento é fruto da importância que damos ao seu patrimônio e uma parte muito importante do mesmo é constituído pelos nossos colaboradores.

Motivação e comprometimento são os valores que acreditamos que devem estar presentes nas ações de todos, independentemente da idade, formação e função.

Construída com muito trabalho e dedicação, esta é uma história muito rica que conta com a sua participação. Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Na Savoy, acreditamos que as pessoas são responsáveis pelos resultados junto com a equipe. Se você gosta do que faz, está sempre querendo aprender mais e quer fazer a diferença, venha trabalhar com a gente. Estamos procurando talentos que queiram se juntar à nossa equipe. Faça parte do nosso time, queremos conhecer o seu potencial.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

Why join us

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the role

As a Senior Project Manager, you will be the driving force behind high-stakes project launches, transforming vision into reality by building autonomous teams and high-impact delivery workflows. This role offers the unique chance to shape product success through Disciplined Agile leadership while mentoring top talent and fostering a vibrant, growth-oriented culture. What you will do

Overall

  • Manage and oversee all phases of the project lifecycle from initiation through closure.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans including resource allocation, scheduling, and risk management.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration among project stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency.
  • Set up processes to ensure successful delivery.
  • Lead and motivate the development team.
  • Identify critical delivery issues and address them with the team before customer exposure.
  • Communicate team issues and concerns to the leadership team.

Project Management

  • Lead project teams in the planning, execution, and delivery of projects.
  • Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.
  • Utilize project management methodologies and best practices to ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks and resolve issues as they arise.
  • Monitor client satisfaction with services and team.
  • Manage expectations and escalations.
  • Implement technical excellence and best practices.
  • Implement process excellence and best practices.
  • Remove process bottlenecks and resolve issues.

Client Ownership

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Conduct regular status meetings and provide detailed project updates to clients.
  • Manage client feedback and address issues promptly and effectively.

Financial Account Management

  • Develop and manage project estimates and budgets.
  • Monitor project financials including expenses, revenue, and profitability.
  • Prepare financial reports and forecasts for internal and client review.
  • Manage team members’ compensation.
  • Monitor and ensure healthy account margins.
  • Manage resources and control financials.

Team Management

  • Launch teams and establish efficient PM processes.
  • Coordinate and oversee the work of project team members including assigning tasks and setting deadlines.
  • Foster a collaborative and productive team environment.
  • Conduct performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback.
  • Consult, mentor, teach, coach, and grow team and client leadership.
  • Ensure team engagement through regular 1:1s, career development, and personal development plans.
  • Coordinate promotions with internal teams and clients.
  • Coordinate the recruiting process with the recruitment team.

Must haves

  • Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Computer Science, or a related field, or relevant work experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in project management with a focus on fixed price and short-term projects.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing projects from start to end including inceptions.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Software Developers, Project Managers, and Account Managers.
  • Strong financial knowledge with experience in managing project budgets and financial reporting.
  • High level of organization, planning, prioritization, and attention to detail.
  • Strong team orientation with the ability to collaborate and influence across multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent client management skills.
  • Proficiency in project management software and tools .
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

Perks and benefits

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.

Descrição da empresa

Quem somos nós?

Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.

A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.

Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional com liderança absoluta em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro, através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?

Coordenador(a) de Treinamento - São Paulo


Somos a HCLTech, uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia e DSA que mais crescem no mundo, com mais de 219.000 profissionais espalhados em 54 países, impulsionando o progresso através de recursos líderes do segmento e centrados nas áreas de Digital, Engenharia e Nuvem.


A força motriz por trás desse trabalho, nosso pessoal, é um público diversificado, criativo e apaixonado, o que nos possibilita estar sempre elevando o padrão de excelência de nossos serviços. De nosso lado, trabalhamos para que cada um de nossos profissionais possa atingir seu melhor, ao mesmo tempo em que nos esforçamos para ajudá-los a encontrar sua inspiração diária e, assim, se tornar a melhor versão de si mesmos.


Estamos à procura de um Coordenador de Treinamento altamente talentoso e automotivado para se juntar a nós em nossa jornada para avançar no mundo tecnológico por meio da inovação e criatividade.


Anexar currículo em Inglês


Requisitos:



  • Excelente comunicação escrita e falada

  • Inglês avançado (Obrigatório)


Seu Papel & Responsabilidades



  • Propriedade do calendário: responsável pelo calendário para todas as partes interessadas (participantes e corpo docente). Atualizar calendários regionais, incluindo calendários do corpo docente e dos participantes.

  • Criação de listas relevantes para a classe e acompanhando os gerentes onde houver incerteza de elegibilidade. Confirmar os detalhes finais da lista com a equipe do corpo docente e sinalizar qualquer coisa digna de nota (por exemplo, participantes de nível sênior).

  • Comunicações: Gerenciar a implantação de comunicações para participantes e gerentes. Criar e gerenciar grupos de bate-papo de corte, incluindo grupos de bate-papo internos com os membros da equipe de ativação e corpo docente atribuídos à corte. Responder às dúvidas dos participantes e gerentes (por e-mail, ping/teams e um sistema de tickets). Criar eventos no LMS para preencher os calendários dos participantes e rastrear os níveis de conclusão. Inscrever os participantes em LPs/eventos relevantes no LMS. Marcar a conclusão/participação do participante após o GSS (quando aplicável).

  • Medição de dados: Atualize o trix com detalhes do participante para dar suporte ao rastreamento de dados.

  • Facilitação: Prepare o deck de boas-vindas e co-facile as sessões de boas-vindas para os participantes.

  • Produção ao vivo para aulas virtuais: Forneça suporte de produção durante as sessões ao vivo, quando relevante.

  • Produção presencial: Como parte de suas responsabilidades, o Coordenador deve estar no local em um escritório específico do cliente para fornecer suporte de produção para módulos presenciais. As responsabilidades para esta parte do programa incluem:

    • Configuração da pré-coorte: Coordenar e concluir a configuração da sala de aula, por exemplo, arranjos de mesa, decoração da sala, requisitos do corpo docente, preparação de material, incluindo apostilas nas mesas, brindes, impressão, adereços educacionais, etc. Coordenar a configuração da tecnologia e garantir que todos os sistemas estejam totalmente funcionais em parceria com a equipe de suporte técnico antes do início da sala de aula. Estabelecer contato com POCs do escritório local, por exemplo, painelistas, bufê, etc.

    • Produção em sala de aula: Rastreamento e acompanhamento de frequência (caso alguém esteja ausente). Ajustes da sala de aula ao longo do dia, por exemplo, configuração de espaços para atividades de breakout. Coordenar POCs do escritório local, por exemplo, painelistas, bufê, etc. Assistência de facilitação, por exemplo, distribuir folhetos, microfone móvel para impulsionar o envolvimento dos participantes, reposição de materiais de sala de aula, etc. Feedback de ação do corpo docente e participantes em relação à configuração/logística da sala.

    • Produção pós-corte: Limpeza e reconfiguração da sala de aula. Armazenamento seguro e inventário de materiais de treinamento. Finalizar e fechar tíquetes abertos com POCs de escritório, incluindo tecnologia e REWS, que exigirão verificações em sala de aula, por exemplo, equipamento de tecnologia devolvido com sucesso (laptops emprestados).



Por que nos escolher?



  • Somos uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia que mais crescem no mundo, com escritórios em mais de 54 países e 219.000 colaboradores. Nossa empresa é extremamente diversificada com 165 nacionalidades representadas.

  • Oferecemos a oportunidade de trabalhar com colegas espalhados ao redor do mundo

  • Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho virtual em primeiro lugar, promovendo uma boa integração entre seu trabalho e vida pessoal, em uma flexibilidade real.

  • Estamos comprometidos com seu crescimento, oferecendo oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento de carreira em todos os níveis para ajudá-lo a encontrar seu brilho único.

  • Oferecemos benefícios abrangentes para todos os funcionários

  • Somos certificados como Great Place to Work e Top Employer em 17 países, e reconhecidos como Top Employer no Brasil especificamente, oferecendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo que valoriza o reconhecimento e o respeito dos funcionários.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Assim, uma vez cadastrado seu currículo poderá ser consultado por toda a rede de franquias e por outras empresas do grupo CVC.
  • Prestar atendimento aos clientes no pré e pós-venda, a fim de garantir satisfação.

  • Proceder à confirmação do embarque do cliente, apresentando relação de documentação necessária, posicionando sobre os riscos de embarque sem a devida documentação, solicitando ciência ao mesmo, orientando sobre disponibilidades de materiais para a viagem, tais como vouchers, passagens, entre outros, com o objetivo de finalizar o processo com sucesso.
  • Desenvolver o processo de reservas no sistema informatizado integrado, realizando as devidas reservas conforme solicitação do cliente, com o objetivo de garantir a vaga no destino evitando a perda da venda.
  • Efetuar o acompanhamento do cliente pós-venda até o termino da viagem, confirmando os serviços contratados, efetuando a entrega dos vouchers/passagens, a fim de auxiliar em caso de dúvidas ou outras necessidades.
  • Utilizar de forma correta as ferramentas disponibilizadas pela CVC, para evitar erros.
  • Realizar de forma frequente os treinamentos disponibilizados pela CVC.
  • Experiência em vendas em qualquer segmento
  • Ensino médio completo (maior de 18 anos) ou graduação (completa ou incompleta) preferencialmente em Turismo, Administração ou área afins.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita e empatia
  • Familiaridade com redes sociais para atendimento ao cliente também via mensagens
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horário do comércio, em lojas de shopping ou de rua
  • Desejável noções de finanças/matemática (Excel e Porcentagem).
  • Conhecimentos gerais de geografia
  • Vontade de aprender em capacitações gratuitas para acelerar seu aprendizado em turismo.

Jornada de treinamento;

Remuneração fixa e comissionamento baseado em performance de vendas.

DIVERSIDADE E RESPEITO

Diversidade e respeito são a nossa bandeira e todas as pessoas são bem-vindas:

  • Mulheres e homens;
  • Pessoas pretas e pardas;

Com mais de 50 anos de história, período em que realizamos os sonhos de viagens de milhares de brasileiros, nós da CVC Viagens também apoiamos a geração de empregos e oportunidades de carreira aos brasileiros, nos mais de 500 municípios do Brasil onde as Lojas Franqueadas CVC estão presentes.

As atividades consistem na movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos. Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

  • Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)

As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.

CONHEÇA NOSSA HISTÓRIA

A Rede de Ensino APOGEU foi fundada no ano 2000, por três jovens empreendedores e ex-alunos do Instituto Tecnológico da Aeronáutica (ITA).

Ao longo do tempo, a instituição vem realizando, com êxito, o seu propósito: já são mais de 4.600 aprovações históricas em universidades públicas de todo o país.

E, em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV: que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira – a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação – junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.

Estamos dedicados a proporcionar uma operação excepcional que prepara os alunos não apenas para sucesso acadêmico, mas também para uma vida de contribuição significativa para a sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

A Nutricionista é responsável pelo monitoramento técnico nutricional nas instituições de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis.

  • Observar as normativas federais do Programa Nacional de Alimentação Escolar - PNAE, as instruções normativas vigentes do Instituto Fundepar e do Conselho Federal de Nutricionista;
  • Atender ao Descrito no ANEXO I.I Alimentação Escolar do Edital de Chamamento Público SEED/PR Nº 17/2024.

Requisitos e qualificações

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Data Science AI Trainer, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design original computational data science problems that simulate real-world analytical workflows across industries (telecom, finance, government, e-commerce, healthcare)

  • Incorporate big data processing scenarios requiring scalable computational approaches
  • Verify solutions using Python with standard data science libraries and statistical methods
  • Document problem statements clearly with realistic business contexts and provide verified correct answers.

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

  • You are an expert in statistical analysis and machine learning with deep understanding of algorithms, methods, and their practical applications.

  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $21/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you’re passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi‑cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let’s contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

The Risk Manager (AVP) will strengthen the company’s risk management framework, with focus on financial risks , and regulatory reporting for a financial institution in Brazil. This role plays a critical function in ensuring robust risk practices, aligned with Banco Central do Brasil (Bacen) requirements, internal risk appetite, and group standards. Experience in designing risk processes for regulatory authorization is a strong advantage.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain the Enterprise Risk Management Framework, ensuring alignment with BCB, CMN Resolutions, and group risk standards.
  • Define and update risk policies, risk appetite statements (RAS), and risk taxonomy.
  • Support risk governance forums, including preparation of materials for Risk Committees and Board‑level reporting.
  • Lead risk assessment models, monitoring, and controls across lending products, investments, credit, and FIDC structures.
  • Oversee operational risk management, including risk & control self‑assessments (RCSA), incident reporting, KRI monitoring, third‑party risk, and business continuity aspects.
  • Evaluate new products, initiatives, and partnerships, conducting Risk & Compliance Assessment (RCA) and issuing signoffs.
  • Coordinate periodic submissions to Bacen, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Prepare risk‑related regulatory documentation and respond to RFIs, audits, and supervisory requests.
  • Support the company’s regulatory authorization process, including designing risk controls tailored for licensing requirements.
  • Develop and enhance risk dashboards, models, and automated reporting for credit, operational, and financial risk indicators.
  • Use data insights to inform business decisions and risk mitigation strategies.

Skills, Experiences & Qualifications

  • Hands‑on leadership style with the ability to make sound technical decisions.
  • Experience in structuring risk process for financial or payment institutions , including regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in Risk functions within financial institutions, fintechs or risk metrics platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Bacen and CMN regulations (ex.: Res. 4.557, 4.970, 4.953).
  • Prior involvement in Bacen authorization/licensing projects is highly valued.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory).
  • Strong analytical mindset and quantitative skills.
  • Structured problem‑solving and risk‑based decision making.
  • High level of ownership, organization, and stakeholder management.

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top‑notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2,000+ customers from high‑growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino’s, and more.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman‑founded, women‑led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world‑class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting‑edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.

Messaging Operations Manager

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced individual to join Insider One and support our Revenue Operations team as a Messaging Operations Manager, specifically focusing on our messaging and WhatsApp products. In this role, you will play a crucial part in driving profits, optimizing deal execution, and managing vendor negotiations. You will be responsible for pricing checks, negotiating special pricing with vendors, and collaborating closely with the sales team to ensure smooth deal execution. Your expertise in vendor management and pricing will be vital for the success of the messaging and WhatsApp product lines.

Additionally, you will drive process enhancements and ensure that our pricing and deal structuring align with the company’s overall goals. Your negotiation skills will help maintain a seamless process from quoting to deal closure, while ensuring compliance with both internal policies and external regulations.

What You Will Do

  • Vendor Negotiation and Pricing Management
  • Lead pricing checks and negotiate special pricing with SMS and WhatsApp vendors.
  • Secure competitive pricing from vendors, ensuring profitability and operational efficiency.
  • Work closely with the sales team to collaborate on pricing, deal structuring, and contract terms.
  • Manage vendor relationships to maintain favorable terms and high service levels.
  • Deal Execution and Rev Ops Collaboration
  • Support the Revenue Operations team in driving profitability and optimizing deal execution.
  • Ensure compliance with internal booking policies and external regulations during deal structuring.
  • Collaborate with sales teams and other key stakeholders to ensure smooth deal execution.
  • Assist in onboarding new sales reps and providing training on quoting tools and CRM systems.
  • Operational Efficiency and Process Enhancements
  • Implement and manage dashboards or reporting tools to monitor deal performance, pricing efficiency, and vendor relationships.
  • Drive process improvements that enhance the team’s scalability and efficiency.
  • Monitor key metrics related to pricing performance, deal closure rates, and vendor management.
  • Market & Trend Analysis
  • Analyze market trends to ensure that pricing remains competitive across different regions.
  • Provide insights on SMS and WhatsApp pricing dynamics to inform strategic decisions.
  • Stay up to date on industry benchmarks to ensure Insider One maintains its competitive edge.

What You Will Need

  • 2-8 years of experience in deal desk operations, pricing, or related areas.
  • Strong negotiation and people skills with a proven track record of vendor management.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and quoting tools.
  • Experience with messaging and WhatsApp products is a plus.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.
  • Comfortable in a fast‑paced environment, capable of managing tight deadlines.

What We Offer

  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.
  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.
  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.
  • Become a Shareowner through our eligibility‑based "ESOP" and own a piece of what you build.
  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.
  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose‑driven social impact projects.
  • From global retreats to team‑building activities, expect year‑round events that turn into lifelong memories.

We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.

To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.

title: Sales Account Manager (Health)
description:
Sales Account Manager (Health) – Elsevier for Health

Join to apply for the Sales Account Manager (Health) role at Elsevier for Health . Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About the business

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

About the team

Elsevier Health applies innovation, facilitates insights, and helps drive more informed decision‑making for our customers across global health. We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence‑based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and supports a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient.

About the role

The Clinical Solutions Account Manager is charged with managing relationships and identifying opportunities for sales of new/additional Clinical Solutions products at Health Systems, Hospitals and Medical Schools within the assigned territory. This will be done via phone and field visits. The Account Manager will be responsible for partnering with the accounts in their territory, calling on key stakeholders to measure and improve client satisfaction of our products, providing analysis of usage and metrics, identify issues.

Responsibilities

  • Identifies key contacts and decision makers based on proper account management and planning using the tools provided by the company (SalesForce.com).
  • Create and implement account management and renewal strategies within the assigned accounts.
  • Drive renewal and upsell opportunities within assigned accounts to meet or exceed quota and annual sales targets.
  • Monitor the stability of accounts by utilizing usage metrics, client satisfaction feedback and develop plans of action to support the overall account strategy.
  • Effectively collaborate with all internal stakeholders including Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Operations and Implementation.
  • Provide accurate reporting and forecasting of sales, keep current records and build account profiles by updating account and contact information and managing account data in our systems.
  • Promote, drive and deliver on any promotional product strategies.
  • Ability to travel 50-60% of the time.

Requirements

  • Consultative Sales Profile : Using customer centric approach to understand the challenges the customer is facing before presenting any products.
  • Customer Focus : Identify customer challenges, get customer acknowledge and connect those to our solutions for providing a customer centric proposal.
  • Building Relationships : Establishes rapport with customers, been perceived as a real business partner rather than a transactional sales person.
  • Driving for Results : Works hard to achieve results and promotes a strong sense of urgency for reaching goals.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork : Encourages co‑operation between all members of the team. Identifies opportunities for further collaboration across teams.
  • Communication : Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message. Use social media to reach new audiences.
  • Proven track record of success from B2B sales, strong technology solution selling experience; healthcare experience is preferred.
  • Experience selling a technology‑based product to hospitals or health systems preferred.
  • Experience in field Sales for at least 3 years – using complex sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Miller Heiman, Franklin Covey or similar.
  • Excellent communication, organizational and analytical skills and follow up skills.
  • Possess and display effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Desire to learn and to share knowledge with other team members.
  • Detailed oriented, a logical thinker, and a good listener.
  • Team and goal oriented.
  • Possess a positive attitude with co‑workers and clients.
  • Ability to maintain good relationships.
  • Ability to use analytical skills to recognize potential sales obstacles and recommend solutions.
  • Highly self‑motivated, organized and able to manage own time.
  • University Degree required, preferred in Health care or engineering.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese. Spanish desirable.
  • Preference to be based in the city of São Paulo, Brazil.

Seniority level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment type

Full‑time

Job function

Finance and Sales

The Senior Regulatory Analyst will be responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance for offshore operations and projects, defining deliverable scopes and deadlines, and supporting engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations teams. This role coordinates regulatory requirements, consolidates technical documentation, assesses compliance risks, supports audits and inspections, and implements action plans to address findings.
